Success Stories: How Online Degrees Are Transforming Careers in India

In this blog, we will showcase stories about different learners with compelling stories and outcomes, with respect to DSU’s online programs – an excellent option for the best online university in India .

The greatest benefit of studying with a UGC approved distance education university is time flexibility. At DSU, we have structured our semesters to offer a combination of live (with small groups/1-on-1), recorded modules, e-tutorials, practical assignments (projects), and group discussions.

Rahul is an example of a mid-level banker in Mumbai who could never navigate into fully studying because he had a pretty demanding job (banking is tough) and has a daughter who was young and chose online studies.

Overcoming Financial Constraints

Degree programs online are way lower cost than conventional degree programs (no hostel cost, no travel cost, and low (not high) tuition fees). Able to support more family members to study without exhausting their savings. DSU’s fee structure is straightforward, plus EMI options to boot.

Sushant is a first-gen learner from Haryana studying DSU’s Online B.Com program. Sushant saved lakhs by not relocating and by not commuting. And with provided feasibility – for example, with electives in Fintech and Business Analytics – Sushant’s increased skill-set allowed him to secure a job with a large NBFC (Non-Banking Financial Company) within a few months of graduation.

Oftentimes, progressing one’s career takes more than simple experience; it requires credentials that prove one’s skill, dedication, and knowledge. Graduates from DSU’s Online MBA and MCA programs have successfully leveraged their degrees to brew viable salary increases or management roles.

Six months following graduation, his new skill set opened the door for him in a new position leading an industrial project while receiving a 35 percent increase in salary.

Online degrees are also going to provide an easy way to change careers. With prescribed electives and personal projects, non-traditional students can create a completely new skill set.

DSU’s Online BCA provided Nisha, a former travel agent, with a new skill set in Full Stack Development—and now she is a developer at a startup company in Bangalore. This transition demonstrates how online degree programs in India can facilitate new opportunities and even identity.
